messages.author: Souvik Dey
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I am trying to use torsional restraints in my PDB file using makeANG_RST.
However, when I type
*"makeANG_RST -pdb amber.pdb -con dihe"*
I end up getting the error.
*Can't open default torsion library file
/home/sdey8/miniconda3/envs/AmberTools20/AmberTools/src/nmr_aux/prepare_input/tordef.lib*
Could someone please guide me as to what I have missed? Why is that file
tordef.lib not present?
Thanks in advance,
Regards,
Souvik Dey
